items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer asks if Irving Mills was the backer or did the show; Interviewee denies both, identifying different people.

ctx.x: I didn't have any headaches with the girls, because they did what I said and they asked no questions. But the point was, the only reason I was successful with this band is because they had unlimited money from the backer.
Who was the backer? Was that Irving Mills?
No, it was a Western fellow in Washington, D.C., kept a half a million standing in the banks. Money was no problem. We bought that All-American sleeper and then I
